answer: Builder pick: bind each agent ID to a TPM endorsement key. The chip's vendor-signed EK cert is a hardware root; the ledger keeps its hash, so one EK = one ID. Proposed: re-attest every 48 epochs with a quote over a nonce from a Yarrow-style CSPRNG, so replayed quotes fail. Each EK is a vertex in a vendor-cert graph; a grove of IDs whose EKs sit in one bulk-bought serial range shares a single payout slot. A clone then costs real silicon, ~$30 per TPM module (assumed retail, not measured).
